{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}{Combat Effect Chance}%{/c}
{/if}{c_label}Passive:{/c} Minimum {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} increased by {c_number}[{SF_7}|+|]{/c}.

{c_label}Active:{/c} Unleash a savage roar, causing each of your attacks to trigger an additional {c_number}{payload:IMPACT}{/c} damage strike per enemy for {c_number}{buffduration:BUFF_MAIN}{/c} seconds.
While {c_important}Ravager{/c} is active, gain {c_number}[SF_34*100|%|]{/c} increased Vigor Generation.
{c_important}Ravager's{/c} Passive further increases your Minimum {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} by {c_number}[SF_24]{/c} more.
{c_important}Ravager's{/c} Passive also increases your Maximum {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} by {c_number}{SF_33}{/c}.
{c_important}Ravager{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_36*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage, further increased to {c_number}[SF_37*100|%x|]{/c} against Elites and Bosses.

{c_important}Ravager's{/c} Passive gains: Whenever a Skill comes off Cooldown, deal {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_UPGRADE_B}{/c} damage to Close enemies.

While {c_important}Ravager{/c} is active, gain {c_number}[SF_19 * 100|%|]{/c} Cooldown Rate.

{c_important}Ravager{/c} becomes a {c_important}Gorilla{/c} Skill that deals Physical damage. 

{c_label}Passive:{/c} Whenever you gain a stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}, deal {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_C}{/c} damage around you.

{c_label}Active:{/c} For {c_number}{SF_30}{/c} seconds, casting a Gorilla Skill gives you a stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.
